steps.label: Harvesting
steps.text: Cacao pods harvested by hand with machetes

steps.label: Extraction
steps.text: Pods opened; beans and pulp removed

steps.label: Fermenting & drying
steps.text: Fermented 5–7 days in boxes, then sun-dried 1–2 weeks

steps.label: Shipping
steps.text: Packed in sacks and shipped to factories

steps.label: Roasting
steps.text: Roasted at 120–150°C; shells removed to leave nibs

steps.label: Mixing & conching
steps.text: Mixed with sugar, milk powder and cocoa butter; refined

steps.label: Tempering & moulding
steps.text: Heated and cooled, poured into moulds, packaged
